value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

battery_programs.notes: SGIP program data refreshed on 2026-08-26 from the official 2026 Handbook and live Program Metrics. Earlier locality records contained 2025 opening/availability language. This record does not assert household eligibility, reservation availability, or a guaranteed incentive; current category and program-administrator status must be checked before reliance.

value.name: Two complete sets of 11" x 17" drawings (residential)
Site plan showing location of major components on the property
Electrical diagram showing PV array configuration, wiring system, overcurrent protection, inverter, disconnects, required signs, and AC connection to building
Specification sheets for all manufactured components (PV modules, inverter(s), combiner box, disconnects, mounting system)

required_documents.notes: Fire Marshal approval is required only for installations covering more than 50% of the total roof area, per the City's own solar-specific submittal guidelines.

value.notes: Processing via the Symbium automated platform (SB 379 compliance) takes approximately 1-3 business days, depending on staff availability.

other_conditions: Three permit categories exist: Solar Residential OL, Solar with ESS Residential OL, and ESS Only Residential OL
Effective January 1, 2025, the Symbium portal became the exclusive submission method

rebates.notes: The city separately operates a Green Building Incentive Program offering building/plan-check fee rebates and expedited review, but specific solar-applicable rebate amounts were not confirmed this session.
